name: Can I convert my tub into a walk-in shower?

mainEntity.name: Can I convert my tub into a walk-in shower?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, converting your tub into a walk-in shower is a common and popular request. This often involves replacing the tub with a low-threshold or curbless shower pan, which provides easier access and a sleek, modern look. We can design and install a walk-in shower that fits within your existing tub footprint or expand it if space allows. This upgrade significantly enhances accessibility and the contemporary feel of your bathroom.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, you can convert your tub into a walk-in shower, often with a low-threshold or curbless pan for easier access and a modern aesthetic.
